subject.title: [Feature]: Remove the Context Profile presets card from Quick Settings

question: Should Quick Settings remove the Context Profile presets card and keep the context-injection and bootstrap budget keys only in Advanced settings/openclaw.json?
rationale: This is a deliberate prominence and product-language decision for the main Settings UI, and the issue is protected with the maintainer label.

options.title: Remove the card
options.body: Approve a focused UI cleanup that deletes the preset card/machinery and preserves only an unsaved-changes action bar in Quick Settings.

options.title: Keep but demote
options.body: Keep a smaller or collapsed shortcut in Quick Settings if maintainers still want context presets discoverable there.

options.title: Leave as-is
options.body: Reject the cleanup and keep the current preset card despite the reported prominence and naming concerns.

recommendation.title: Remove the card
recommendation.body: Approve a focused UI cleanup that deletes the preset card/machinery and preserves only an unsaved-changes action bar in Quick Settings.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened this protected maintainer-decision issue and recently carried the related Settings declutter work.
